line.en: Hard-enamel pins with gold outlines pressed one by one into deep green felt, words set in enamel banners, each glinting as it lands.
line.zh-CN: 金色描边的硬珐琅徽章一枚枚按进深绿毛毡，文字做成珐琅横幅，落定时闪过一道光。

for.en: Playful promos and short explainers in a few bright beats: what something does in three emblems, one figure, a comparison, a name to keep; launches, clubs, events, fun facts.
for.zh-CN: 节奏轻快的宣传片和短讲解：用三枚徽章讲清它能做什么、一个数字、一组对比、一个记得住的名字；发布、社团、活动、趣味知识。

not.en: Long or detailed explanations, diagrams and maps; serious or sombre subjects; more than a few words at a time.
not.zh-CN: 冗长或细致的讲解、示意图和地图；严肃或沉重的题材；一次超过几个词的文字。
